description: This file defines a class implementing a method for unregistering plugins in the Smarty templating engine. It contains a class named 'Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterPlugin' with a method 'unregisterPlugin' which removes a plugin from Smarty's registered plugins.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterPlugin
classes.description: Class for managing plugin unregistration within Smarty templating system.

methods.name: unregisterPlugin
methods.description: Unregisters a plugin of a specified type and name from Smarty's registered plugins.
